sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 3
PLD 2021 Punjab Statutes 3
ACT III OF 2021
PUNJAB TRANSPARENCY AND RIGHT TO
INFORMATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the Punjab Transparency and Right
to Information Act 2013 (XXV of 2013)
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
17th March, 2021]
No.
PAP/Legis-3(55)/2021/2494, dated 17.3.2021.---The Punjab Transparency and Right to Information (Amendment) Bill
2021, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on March 02,
2021, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on March 16, 2021, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Punjab Transparency and Right to Information Act
2013 (XXV of 2013), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Transparency and Right to Information
(Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

3. Amendment
in section 6 of Act XXV of 2013.---In
the Act, in section 6:
(i) for
subsection (4), the following shall be substituted:
"(4)
While inquiring into a complaint, any Commissioner subject to distribution of
work by Chief Information Commissioner or any other person authorized by the
Commission, may examine any information on spot, and
(ii) for

"(6)

provisions of this Act during a financial year by 31 August and shall lay it
